title: Map Latin American country codes
question: Does the legacy Latin America label identify a single numeric GCAM region?
timestamp_note: Envelope retrieval timestamps use a fixed replay clock, not publisher retrieval times. Actual fixture capture times appear in the manifest; null means unrecorded.
answer: 49 country and territory codes share the legacy label but map to 9 numeric region IDs.
limitations: Country and territory codes belong to this model release. They do not define political boundaries.

source_notes: Title: ISO to GCAM region mapping
